description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the North Carolina General Statutes — North Carolina state law — by citation. "N.C.G.S. 14-17" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does North Carolina General Statute 14-17 say" or to check an NC statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "14-17" or "20-138.1". The chapter is the part before the first dash.

name: nc_general_statute
title: Nc General Statute
